title: azalea canadensis
intro: Azalea canadensis, commonly known as the Florida azalea or pink azalea, is a flowering plant species native to the southeastern United States. This shrub is known for its clusters of pink or white flowers and is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Azalea canadensis include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties, including antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities.
